note: [R68-b2] _if_extract_cond_instructions Pattern C2: accept the SWAP-N terminal form of the fixed-length tuple assignment whose targets are cell variables (CPython 3.11: <e1>..<eN> + SWAP N + stores in SOURCE order). Recognised only from this block's own consecutive-store run, this block's own pending value segment (last non-noise instruction is SWAP with arg == N, exactly one SWAP) and this block's own reconstructed stack depth >= N. The SWAP carries no value, so it is dropped from the value segment and the existing C2 reduction emits one Assign(Tuple, Tuple) with targets in STORE source order (not reversed). Fixes scheduler::run_daily 44->45/45 and synth r68b2_cell_tuple 2/3 -> 3/3; without SWAP the old reverse-store rule still applies byte-for-byte. || [R68-b2] Pattern SIG2 in _generate_block_statements_body: when the block's own instruction stream has SWAP N immediately before the run of N consecutive simple-name stores, the tuple assignment targets are cell variables and the stores are already in SOURCE order, so targets must not be reversed. SWAP is in SKIP_OPS and therefore invisible to stmt_instrs / _s2_has_swap. The two orderings are mutually exclusive, so the no-SWAP reverse rule is untouched.
